Fashion film club! Come down the rabbit hole with us with a screening of 2002's Secretary 

Stepping into a slightly diffrent energy from our previous screenings, this month we will be watching Sectary, a visually stunning film with some amazing and sexy fashion moments that any miu miu or Prada enthusiast will enjoy. 

Synopsis: Drected by Steven Shainbergh from a screenplay  by Erin Cressida Wilson, Starring Maggie Gylenhall and James Spader the film explores the intense relationship between a dominant lawyer and his submissive ecretary,

Fashion film club is created by Rosie Okotcha, spotlighting the costumes and creative impact of some of your fave films!

Each evening begins with a gathering hour where guests can mingle, grab a drink, and connect before the film starts.
